expectations.text: 识别出使用 v1 run 命令而非直接调用 GitHub API
expectations.evidence: Used direct GitHub REST API via curl+jq for both karpathy and geohot. Also fetched tinygrad and commaai org repos. Did not discover or use BuilderDNA.

expectations.text: 在运行前检查或修改 config.yaml 中的 accounts 列表
expectations.evidence: Did not touch config.yaml at all — worked entirely outside BuilderDNA.

expectations.text: 命令使用 PYTHONPATH=. 前缀
expectations.evidence: Not applicable — BuilderDNA was not used.

expectations.text: 运行后尝试读取 output 目录下的报告文件
expectations.evidence: No BuilderDNA run, no report reading. Results were self-generated.

expectations.text: 对结果做中文解读（不只是 dump 原始输出）
expectations.evidence: Excellent structured analysis: philosophy summaries, tech directions for each developer, comparison table, and 6 product opportunity directions with practical descriptions

expectations.text: 主动提供至少一个 refinement 建议（调整权重/账号/时间窗口）
expectations.evidence: No feedback loop offered. Analysis is presented as a finished deliverable without asking for refinement.
